description: This file is an initialization module for torch.backends, defining context managers, classes, and functions to manage backend flags and precision settings, and importing various backend modules.

classes.name: ContextProp
classes.description: Descriptor class for managing context-based property access for backend flags.

classes.name: PropModule
classes.description: Custom module class that delegates attribute access to an internal module.

classes.name: _FP32Precision
classes.description: Class for managing FP32 precision settings for a specific backend and operation.

classes.name: GenericModule
classes.description: Subclass of PropModule that provides a context property for FP32 precision.

methods.name: flags_frozen
methods.description: Checks if backend flags are frozen (mutation not allowed).

methods.name: __allow_nonbracketed_mutation
methods.description: Context manager to temporarily allow mutation of backend flags.

methods.name: set_flags
methods.description: Sets FP32 precision flags for the 'generic' backend.

methods.name: flags
methods.description: Context manager to temporarily set FP32 precision flags.

methods.name: _get_fp32_precision_getter
methods.description: Returns a getter function for FP32 precision for a given backend and operation.

methods.name: _set_fp32_precision_setter
methods.description: Returns a setter function for FP32 precision for a given backend and operation.
